results.fact: Kangaroo Pass pin (waypoints[2]) off its feature
results.evidence: The stored pin (48.507339,-120.629967) sits at USGS ground 5,661 ft, not on a pass; the named OSM saddle node Kangaroo Pass is at 48.5015712,-120.62226 (ground 6,665 ft, matching the claimed 6,671). But the row claims the south-face approach tops out at Kangaroo Pass, while the published approach heads toward Kangaroo Pass (about 3 mi from the car) and turns off before it to cross Kangaroo Ridge at the broad col dead centre between Half Moon and Big Kangaroo; moving the pin to the true pass would put a ~1 km southern detour into the drawn line for a point the route may not visit. Pin left unchanged; recommend removing or renaming it once the actual turn-off is located.

results.fact: Half Moon–Big Kangaroo col pin (waypoints[3]) off its feature

results.fact: Basin below Whistler Mountain pin (waypoints[2])
results.evidence: Pin at 48.524506,-120.705127 is ground 7,080 ft vs claimed 6,200, only ~200 m from the summit (GNIS/OSM 48.5263,-120.7035). Ground elevations at pins 2-6 are 7,080 / 6,765 / 6,325 / 5,756 / 5,055 ft, i.e. they step DOWN toward the SR-20 pullout (ground 5,227) while their names/elevs step UP the ridge (6,200 to 7,900), so the coordinates trace the lower southeast approach (in reverse) rather than the west ridge. No source states a coordinate for this basin; unchanged.

results.fact: White Rock Lakes pin (waypoints[7]) off the lakes, wrong elevation and sequence note
results.evidence: OSM camp node "White Rock Lakes Camp" states 48.3395954,-121.052078 (GNIS lake point 48.340745,-121.056975, ~0.4 km across the lake group). USGS ground there is 6,188 ft; published camp elevations are ~6,200 and 6,229 ft, and the row's own bivy entry says 6,200, so elev 6500 -> 6200. Itineraries order the route LeConte Glacier -> South Cascade Glacier -> White Rock Lakes -> Dana Glacier -> Spire Col, so the note's claim that the camp "crosses the South Cascade Glacier en route to Spire Point" is reworded. The pin NAME ("White Rock Lakes / South Cascade Glacier Col") was left as is because bivy[] hides this waypoint by that exact name (bivy is owned by the camping clean-up); recommend renaming both to "White Rock Lakes" together.

results.fact: Yang-Yang Lakes listed before Spider-Formidable Col
results.evidence: Every itinerary (and the row's own prose: "climb the Middle Cascade Glacier to Spider-Formidable Col, descend to Yang-Yang Lakes") crosses the col BEFORE Yang Yang Lakes, but waypoints[5] (Yang-Yang, distMi 12) precedes waypoints[6] (col, distMi 13.5). Both distances are unsourced and the list order cannot be swapped with the patch ops; recommend swapping entries 5 and 6 and nulling both distMi before the line is redrawn.
